# Afterparty

> Self-hosted Partiful scraper and guest list exporter. It syncs the events and guest lists of a Partiful account into PostgreSQL through Partiful's web API, then serves a web app and a JSON API to search, filter, map and export people to CSV. FastAPI, PostgreSQL, React and a Chrome (Manifest V3) extension. MIT license.

Run it with Docker Compose (`docker compose up -d --build`, then http://localhost:8080). Agents can query a running instance with the client in `skills/afterparty/scripts/afterparty.py` and the token from Settings > API access for agents.

- [Self-hosting](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doluz/afterparty/main/docs/self-hosting.md): Docker, from source, Firebase sign-in, servers, Cloud Run, daily sync, backups, all settings
- [Connector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doluz/afterparty/main/docs/connector.md): what the Chrome extension does, its permissions, loading it, publishing it
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/doluz/afterparty/main/docs/architecture.md): components, how Partiful is read, data model, security
